module.Title: Return a Result
module.Teaching: A method with a non-void return type sends a value back to the code that called it.
module.PredictionExplanation: The method declaration begins with bool, so every return path must provide true or false.
module.DebugPrompt: The comparison is calculated but never returned. Add the return keyword.
module.RecallPrompt: Write IsAlive from memory. Use the exact identifier health. Use the exact value 0.
module.TransferPrompt: Create HasStone that returns whether count is greater than zero. Use the exact value 0.
module.PreviewMessage: Game rules can now return answers.
